capabilities: Correct spelling, grammar, and punctuation in selected text
Correct entire notes and Markdown files
Skip unchanged corrections and keep them bound to their note
Connect a Constance account and buy credits
Keep local recovery records and preferences across updates
disambiguation: Despite the name, it corrects grammar and punctuation as well as spelling.
extras: README is mostly account, billing (Paddle, USD), privacy, and recovery details; functional usage is thin. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian's built-in spellcheck only flags misspellings and offers no AI fix for grammar and punctuation across selections, whole notes, or Markdown files.

relations.evidence: Connect your Constance account in plugin settings.

summary: Corrects spelling, grammar, and punctuation in selected text, notes, and Markdown files using OpenRouter.
